verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents a first-party webhook plugin that forwards error and project data to an HTTP endpoint as soon as BugSnag receives and processes it. That is a registrable outbound HTTP callback a programmatic consumer can receive. The Slack, Teams and PagerDuty integrations are chat or incident notifications, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of selectable event types or subscription filters, payload schema, signing or authentication of deliveries, retry behavior, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
